# RiftWarden

`creature`

An ancient construct of crystallised voidite that guards the innermost rift boundary. Moves slowly but is virtually immune to physical damage. Warden fragments are the rarest material in the game — a single Warden kill can supply a guild with enough voidite-grade components for weeks.

> Serve as the ultimate endgame encounter; require guild-level preparation and sustained void knowledge

## Actions

### detect

Detect intrusion into the innermost rift boundary

**Conditions:**
- Detects all players inside the innermost rift boundary zone unconditionally
- Cannot be avoided by stealth; rift proximity triggers detection
- Fires attack trigger directly from idle — no alert phase

### attack

Ground slam pulse and void beam discharge

**Conditions:**
- Ground slam: baseDamage in 6-tile radius; all targets knocked down (prone for 3 seconds)
- Void beam: 3× baseDamage in a straight 10-tile line; also adds 50 void corruption to each target hit
- Physical damage reduced by 90%; magical and void damage is fully effective
- VoidTouched players receive only 50% corruption from void beam (partial resistance)

### die

Transition to dead state; crystalline body shatters releasing shards

**Conditions:**
- Death emits a death event; shard fragments scatter in a 4-tile radius and must be individually collected

### drop

Drop loot on death

**Conditions:**
- Always drops: rift warden shard (4–8), void-core crystal (1)
- Chance drop: warden sigil (5%) — grants permanent void corruption resistance +25% when carried

### respawn

Reconstitute at the rift core after an extended cooldown

**Conditions:**
- Respawn cooldown: 120 in-game minutes (longest in the game)
- Only one Warden instance exists per VoidRift zone; does not multi-spawn

### calm

Return to slow patrol of the innermost boundary

**Conditions:**
- Returns to idle if all players leave the innermost rift boundary zone
